title: Share the native Node predicate used by registered wrapper and doc-link classification
outcome: The two exact-Node admissions share one maintained predicate or are explicitly retained with a documented reason, preserving all current accepted/refused executable forms.
acceptance: The wrapper Test and doc-link Lint routes retain their existing Node path and .cmd/.bat/.ps1 refusal behavior.
Any helper extraction remains local to registered classification and does not widen ordinary command recognition.
